id: title:jose-sequeira:group consumer debug pods into collapsible deployments

review.reason: The observed changes are strictly limited to the ingestion control-plane consumer debug UI. review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the observed code, which demonstrates a narrow, localized maintenance and readability improvement. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a stable, IP-aware worker sort key and preserves row order while retaining load-based priority.
observations.posthog_connection: Ingestion control-plane consumer debug UI; prevents rows from jumping while workers are reloaded, preserving the visual association between a pod and its worker metrics.

observations.behavior: Replaces a simple namespace header with a collapsible deployment header and adds a ready-status indicator.
observations.posthog_connection: Ingestion control-plane consumer debug UI; enables expanding a deployment to reveal its pods and their live metrics without cluttering the namespace view.

observations.behavior: Adds a relative-time formatter for pod start and worker metrics, and a helper to format integers.
observations.posthog_connection: Ingestion control-plane consumer debug UI; improves readability of timestamps and pod counts in the pod and worker status rows.
